name: ModelVariant846_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant846_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two bolts, launched at two set times, leave a model point and fly towards a jittered point on the opposing slot, wrapped in a ring of sprites and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a fading ribbon and smoke puffs; on arrival each flares into a glow ringed by 64 drifting flecks, with two fans of rays and animated sparks, while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolt rings, puffs, flecks, rays and sparks and packs six texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once when the first bolt arrives, 1 once when the last bolt arrives, 2 once the last glow has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-863 and 960 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
